description: Inputs the runtime must refuse. Each case names the substring the returned error has to contain. The cross-check script skips this set: how a runtime reports a refusal is a property of its API, while the arithmetic is what has to agree across languages. The Go runner owns these assertions.

provenance.oracle: ADR-0002 §2.1 (exact operations trap rather than round), §2.3 (policies come from content and are validated on the way in) and §2.6 (allocation with no proportion has no answer)
provenance.contentVersion: n/a — engine vectors, authored against the ADR rather than against a content bundle

cases.oracle: The exact sum needs 61 significant digits and the context carries 34. ADR-0002 §3.1: an exact operation that cannot be exact is a defect, and a trap turns it into a stack trace rather than a number that still looks like a number.
(1 + 1E-17)^2 needs 35 significant digits. One digit finer than arithmetic/mul-thirty-three-significant-digits, which is exact — the pair locates the boundary rather than asserting it is somewhere.

General Decimal Arithmetic Specification: division by zero is a trapped condition. Untrapped it yields Infinity, and an infinite tax amount that reaches a fiscal document is worse than a failed request.

Specification: quantize is invalid when the result would need more digits than the context's precision — here 43 against 34. The operation refuses rather than returning a rounded approximation of a number it cannot hold.

ADR-0002 §2.4: the mode enum is closed, and adding a member is a SCHEMA train change with a new golden-vector set. Content naming a mode this build does not implement is a bundle/runtime mismatch, not a rounding question.
ADR-0002 §2.3: the basis enum is LINE, DOCUMENT, TAX_COMPONENT, JURISDICTION_TOTAL. INVOICE is plausible enough to be typed by a rule author, which is exactly why it is rejected at the boundary.
MaxScale is 12 — well beyond any currency minor unit and any rate precision expected. A scale past it is malformed content, and failing loudly is the point of the bound.
A negative scale would round to tens or hundreds. If an authority ever mandates that, it arrives as a reviewed change to the bound with vectors of its own, not as content that happens to pass.
ADR-0002 §2.3: scale 0 is legal, so an absent scale must not be read as a scale of zero. A JPY policy and a policy that forgot to say differ by nothing but this rejection.

Content is signed and versioned. A key this build does not understand means the bundle was authored against a different SCHEMA train version, and ignoring it would silently apply a policy other than the one the author approved.
ADR-0002 §2.6: there is no proportion to divide by, and choosing a line to carry the amount would be a fiscal decision taken in Go rather than in content.

A negative weight has no fractional remainder that ranks against a positive one, so the largest-remainder guarantee does not survive the mix. A document with offsetting lines is allocated by magnitude, by the caller, with the sign reapplied.
Distributing a total across nothing has no answer. Returning an empty allocation would silently discard the total.
